retail.headline: Former Flipkart group employees launch petition seeking inclusion in proposed $2 billion Esop buyback
retail.hook: On October 10, a group of former executives launched a petition aiming to bring together 20,000-30,000 former employees of Flipkart and its group companies, including Myntra, Cleartrip, Shopsy, Super Money and ANS…
retail.summary: On October 10, 2023, a group of former executives from Flipkart and its associated companies, including Myntra, Cleartrip, Shopsy, Super Money, and ANS, initiated a petition to advocate for their inclusion in a proposed $2 billion Employee Stock Ownership Plan (Esop) buyback. retail.headline: E-commerce festive sales touch Rs 24,000 crore in first two days, mobiles lead

retail.summary: E-commerce companies in India generated approximately Rs 24,000 crore in sales during the first two days of the festive season, with mobile phones accounting for nearly 40% of the total revenue. retail.summary: Carlsberg India's brewery in Alwar has been ordered to shut down due to a breach of pollution norms, specifically high particulate emissions that were reported to be eight times above the permissible limit. world.headline: India's opposition parties march to top court as protests over voter lists escalate
